text:
Maya: Quick note from this morning's partner call — they want tenant webhooks + CSV export before GA. Both are customer-visible and would be great, but they increase surface area. Need to decide cut or shift.

Kai: Short take: webhooks are higher risk (security + delivery semantics), exports are easier. If we have to pick one, export wins for adoption signals.

Priya: Sales wants webhooks for onboarding automation. They said without it the pilot will be manual and slower. Can we offer a narrow webhook pilot (one-event, one-tenant) behind a support flow?

Rene: Engineering reality: webhooks require retries, dead-letter handling, signing, and tests. ETA for a robust implementation ~5 weeks. A gated one-off webhook webhook proxy for 1 tenant could be done faster (~2 weeks) but it adds operational overhead.

Jordan: Design can make a simple export UX in one sprint. Webhooks UX for admin setup needs more safeguard language and guidance.

Maya: Proposal: keep GA date but re-scope MVP to exclude general webhooks. Offer a limited webhook pilot (manual setup + feature-flag) to key partners. Move full webhooks to v1. Keep CSV export in MVP.

Kai: Agree. Also add a perf contingency: if the token-cost targets from the new batching patch are not met in canary, we delay GA by one week.

Rene: I'll schedule perf runs and a quick subsystems smoke test for webhooks proxy if we pursue the pilot. Also: request freeze on introducing new model optimizations into GA runtime until after canary.

Priya: I'll tell sales to prep the partner for a manual webhook pilot and confirm they accept a scoped pilot ask.

Jordan: Actionable design tasks:
- Export modal + CSV template (ship in 1 sprint)
- Admin docs for webhook pilot (short checklist)

Maya: Milestone plan (dates tentative):
- 4/01: GA feature freeze (everything gated to must-haves)
- 4/05: perf canary + batching patch verification (Rene)
- 4/08: docs + export UI ready (Jordan)
- 4/10: sales/partners informed + pilot signups (Priya)
- 4/12: final go/no-go decision (Kai/Maya)

Rene: I'll post canary numbers to the milestones board. If RBAC or perf regressions show up, we use one-week buffer.

Kai: Decisions logged:
- Keep GA date as primary plan.
- Remove general webhooks from MVP; enable single-tenant webhook pilot behind feature flag and manual ops.
- Keep CSV export in MVP.
- Contingency: 1-week delay if perf/canary fails.

release-bot: Created ticket #5012 "GA-scope: exports in MVP, webhooks pilot + v1" and linked PR #4620.

Maya: I'll update the milestone board and ping CS + legal about the pilot constraints. Will post the updated board by EOD. :white_check_mark:

Priya: I'll coordinate pilot onboarding docs with Jordan and CS.

Rene: Starting perf runs now; ETA for numbers ~3 hours.

Kai: Thanks all — this reduces risk while keeping launch momentum. We'll reconvene if canary flags issues. :thumbsup:
